title: NIL craft
description: A clean optimization template for playing on your own worlds, with shaders included. Fast, lightweight, and easy to build on.
body: A clean optimization template for playing on your own worlds, with shaders included. Built on Fabric with mods like Sodium, Lithium, and more to keep the game running smoothly without changing the vanilla experience. Complementary Reimagined shaders with iris included for when you want to turn up the visuals.
